summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Azkar and Audio Quran features for Sadaqa Jaryeh app. All requested flows verified successfully: Language picker persists in localStorage; Home dock has 5 buttons with Audio enabled; Azkar screen loads 21 morning zikr cards with working counters (decrement + green-complete state, persists under azkar_counter_<cat>_YYYY-M-D key); All 9 expected categories present in sidebar (morning, evening, after_prayer, sleep, waking, duha, travel, food, general); Category switching, font size +/-, individual reset, reset-all confirm all work; Audio Quran screen renders all 7 verses of Al-Fatihah, audio element loads everyayah.com URL (https://everyayah.com/data/Alafasy_128kbps/001001.mp3) and plays successfully (paused=false, currentTime=5.42, duration=6.03); Next button advances to 'Al-Fatihah 1:2'; Reciter panel lists all 5 reciters (Alafasy, Husary, Minshawy, Abdul Basit, Sudais) and selection persists to localStorage 'audio_quran_reciter'; Surah list shows 114 surahs, selecting Al-Baqarah switches to 'Al-Baqarah 2:1'; Mode toggle to 'Full surah' changes audio URL to mp3quran.net pattern (https://server8.mp3quran.net/afs/002.mp3); Back buttons from both screens return to Home with dock visible.
critical_code_review_comments: AudioQuranScreen.tsx auto-resume effect uses wasPlayingRef whose value is updated in a separate effect on [playing], creating a race: when user clicks next while playing, the playing state may flip to false before the URL-change effect reads wasPlayingRef. Consider tracking last-user-intent in a ref directly inside togglePlay/goNext rather than mirroring playing state. (Functionality still works in test because audio played continuously.)

AzkarScreen.tsx counterKey uses local date without zero-padding (YYYY-M-D vs YYYY-MM-DD). Acceptable since it's only used as a localStorage key, but a typical convention would zero-pad for sortability.
Both screens import Google Fonts inside style tags inside the component (re-injected on every mount). Move to index.html <link> tags or index.css @import for performance.

AzkarScreen.tsx ring button currently shows remaining count starting at full (e.g., '1' for a 1-count zikr) which is slightly ambiguous — when count is 1, the gold button shows '1' both before and immediately after one tap (it turns into ✓ green only when fully complete). Tested: this works correctly. Just a minor UX note for multi-count zikr (33, 100) where users may wonder if ring is countdown or count-up; it IS countdown which is correct.
AudioQuranScreen.tsx initial verseId is hardcoded to 1 on mount — does not persist last-played verse across screen exits like surahId does (audio_last_surah only saves surah, not verse). Minor.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Pre-set localStorage 'sadaqa_lang' to 'en' to bypass language picker on subsequent runs
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Azkar and Audio Quran features work as specified. The language picker uses prefixed-emoji text ('🇬🇧 English', '🇸🇦 العربية') so don't match 'English' with exact=True — use button[has-text] filter or set localStorage.setItem('sadaqa_lang', 'en') before reload. Bottom dock buttons are identified by emoji ('🎧' last, '📿' last — there are 2 of 📿 because Home also shows the smart Azkar card with 📿 icon). data-testid coverage is excellent on Azkar/Audio screens; HomeScreen dock buttons themselves do NOT have data-testid (use emoji-text selectors). Audio playback confirmed working with public CDN everyayah.com and mp3quran.net — no network/CORS issues observed in test environment.
